decision: Material v0.1 remains file-based; external downstream contracts are referenced by repo/path/revision and are never copied/redefined as XDT1-owned.
rationale: Rule Keeper requires existing canonical artifacts to be reused
No evidence requires a database, service, UI, or parallel router
restrictions: Unknown/conflicting ownership is unresolved and escalated
Material Plans do not grant implementation authority
Downstream repositories are read-only to XDT1 unless separately delegated
